name: inkos
title_zh: 把小说、剧本、互动叙事全流程装进一个 Agent
tagline_zh: 从长篇连载到多分支互动电影，写完还能翻成多语言 EPUB/PDF。自带可追溯研究、受控上下文和持久故事状态。
tagline_en: From long novels to branching interactive films, write then translate to EPUB/PDF. Built-in traceable research.
desc_en: Story Creation and Translation AI Agent with Studio Chat, CLI, and TUI - use for long-form novels, short fiction, scripts, storyboards, interactive-film projects, open-world / branching play, fan fiction, spinoffs, style imitation, continuations, covers, and multilingual EPUB/PDF/TXT/Markdown translation. Includes Agent Skills, traceable research, governed context, persistent story state, multi-mo
why_zh: 不是聊天套壳，而是把故事状态、研究笔记、上下文预算做成显式工程构件，多模态 CLI/TUI/Studi。
why_en: Not a chat wrapper—story state, research notes, and context budget are explicit engineered artifacts. One state machine across.
limit_zh: 只认文本创作域：小说、剧本、分镜、互动叙事。不做代码、不做数据分析。需要你已有 Python 3.10+ 和 Node。
limit_en: Text-fiction only: novels, scripts, storyboards, interactive narrative. No code, no data analysis. Requires Python 3.10+ and Node 18+. Exports only.
